events.subject: atlas-percorsi
events.statement: Recovered TRAMA PR #96 as the authoritative G1 knowledge package for Atlas Percorsi; fixed-eight student pathway reconstruction is invalid.
events.rationale: PR #96 contains the canonical index, backlog-zero plan, productive workflow, grammar registry, dossier template, pedagogical model, child-safe constitution, evidence records, dossier and implementation spec for PW-MISSING-INFORMATION-01.

events.subject: project-knowledge
events.statement: Use TRAMA Project Knowledge Base and Context Packs as the primary operational memory; conversational memory is only a pointer, never technical authority.
events.rationale: Implements CC2-F1/E and ADR-015 to avoid repeated reconstruction from chats.

events.subject: project-knowledge
events.statement: Do not use chat history or assistant memory as the canonical source of technical state.
events.rationale: Chat context can be incomplete or unavailable; strong facts must resolve to governed repository/control-center sources.

events.subject: project-knowledge-live-collector
events.statement: LIVE_ONE_SHOT remains blocked until a real credential principal and authoritative read-only permission attestation are bound to the frozen candidate.
events.rationale: Stage C and the Second Brain projection are integrated, but the human decision gate requires a concrete principal/permission envelope before any live network execution.

events.subject: development-continuity
events.statement: Start work from governed Context Packs and canonical sources; verify only volatile facts, then use a continuous end-to-end implementation/test/review cycle unless authority, contract, security, privacy, write autonomy, approval semantics or irreversible decisions change.
events.rationale: Prevents repeated reconstruction from chat while preserving strengthened governance at real decision boundaries.
